tools.name: p4
tools.$comment: Perforce Helix Core CLI (p4). p4-kit is the declared owner of this tool; this entry is kept BYTE-IDENTICAL in fulfillment to p4-kit/bootstrap.json so the two declarations resolve and report the same way. macOS uses the `p4` cask (CLI-only: a single p4 binary), NOT the `perforce` cask (which also ships p4d/p4p/p4broker) -- both exist and both provide p4, and the narrower one matches the CLI-only scope. Structured install descriptors are required, not opaque strings: an opaque string bypasses the brew strategy, never receives the `elevation` descriptor, and so can never be collapsed with other brew-backed failures. Any change here must be mirrored in p4-kit/bootstrap.json.

ubuntu.command: wget -qO - https://package.perforce.com/perforce.pubkey | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/perforce.gpg > /dev/null && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/perforce.gpg] https://package.perforce.com/apt/ubuntu noble release' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/perforce.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y helix-cli

uproject.agent_msg: Ask the user for their .uproject file path. Write it to {config_path} AND to <project_root>/.local-data/plugins-kit/unreal-kit/config.yaml (the per-project config).

engine_dir.agent_msg: Ask the user for their UE engine directory. Write it to {config_path} AND to <project_root>/.local-data/plugins-kit/unreal-kit/config.yaml (the per-project config).

plugins._comment: Self-referential on purpose: the engine enforces that unreal-kit itself stays installed and enabled at user scope (re-installs on scope drift). Unknown keys like this one are ignored by the engine.
